newsitem.title: UK: United to make 83 mln stg provision.
newsitem.headline: United to make 83 mln stg provision.

text.p: Britain's United Utilities Plc said on Friday that it will make a provision of 83 million stg, bringing the total to 90 million, after reassessing the position on its Bangkok contract.

The multi-utility company has been engaged in the construction of a sewage treatment works and associated sewerage network in Bangkok since late 1993 with a contract value at the time of the award of 150 million stg.
It said that the contract has been affected by delays and additional work which has led to additional costs which, under the terms of the contract, are reimbursable.
United said that it intends to pursue recovery of additional costs it has incurred despite being told by the Governor of Bangkok that it could no longer consider its claims valid.
United was told that if it wished to recover costs, it would need to give formal notification of a dispute and allow that dispute to be settled by arbitration.

"In the light of that change of approach by the client, the board has concluded that, in the interests of financial prudence it should make an additional provision on the contract," said the company in a statement.
It said the provision for its 1996/97 results anticipates that additional costs from the project will not be recovered.
United also said that developments on the Bangkok contract do not affect its prospects and note that its dividend policy and the scope to return value to shareholders will not be affected.
